correctness.rationale: The autonomous behavioral marginal yields a killed-generator equilibrium system M(s)x=diag(v)pi. Its determinant stays strictly positive by the positive-killing semigroup. The adjugate numerator for p_A(s)-c has degree at most m−1. The complete-graph rank-one inverse has a strictly positive denominator, and Lagrange interpolation at negative nodes with sufficiently small residues constructs any prescribed m−1 distinct positive switching-rate zeros using strictly positive movement rates. The exact three-mode rational formula was independently reconstructed; the standalone checker passed 116 exact-rational supplementary assertions. Finite tests supplement, not replace, the complete proof.

value.rationale: The sharp mode-count law places a complete mathematical limit on how changing behavioral switching speed alone may reverse the preferred of two habitats, despite invariant long-run behavioral frequencies. The constructive theorem shows any positive set of m−1 reversal points is possible with strictly positive rates, while the m=3 example shows a fixed mode-isolated weighted mixture can miss reentrant preference. These are motivated, interpretable structural boundaries for state-switching habitat-use models, not a routine numeric perturbation, a field claim, or a rephrasing of a tabulated value.
